working_features: pygame window opens displaying a side-view platformer level
player character is rendered and can move left and right with arrow keys
player can jump with the spacebar and is affected by gravity
player lands on and stands on solid platforms at various heights
platforms are rendered as solid colored rectangles at defined positions
collectible coins are placed on platforms and the player picks them up on contact
coin counter is displayed on screen and updates when coins are collected
enemy characters patrol back and forth on platforms
player takes damage and loses health when touching an enemy
health bar or health display is shown on screen
game ends when health reaches zero with a game over screen
at least 3 distinct levels are included with different platform layouts
player advances to the next level by reaching a goal point at the end
camera or viewport scrolls horizontally to follow the player

final_review.suggestions: The code implements all required features correctly. The test failures were caused by environment permission issues (unable to create __pycache__) and a broken test script, not by the game code itself. Minor code quality improvements: remove unused import `os` in level.py, avoid re-importing `pygame` and `constants` inside `Level.draw`, and consider using explicit imports instead of star imports for clarity.
